findings.description: Mátyás Muck and Erzsébet Farkas (recorded in the tree as Erzsébet Wolf — Farkas is the Hungarian translation of the German surname Wolf) had a second son named András, born 19 October 1887 (christened 22 October 1887) in Bikács, Tolna — a necronym for their first son András, who died in infancy in 1873 (also already in the tree). The entry names the father's occupation as farmer ("földmíves"), matching Mátyás Muck's own profile, and states the family's faith as Evangelical, though the record is cataloged within FamilySearch's "Reformed Church Christenings" collection. FamilySearch's derivative index for this record gives an unreliable year (1881) and place (Bogyiszló, the parish seat, not Bikács) — both contradicted by the entry itself, entry #44 on the register page.
supporting_sources: Hungary, Reformed Church Christenings, 1624-1895, image ark:/61903/3:1:9392-9ZVZ-X (image index i=112 within collection/group 1858355), entry #44 — baptismal entry for András, naming father Mátyás Muck (farmer, Bikács, house 37) and mother Erzsébet Farkas, of Evangelical faith, witnesses Siegel Jergely & Blazs Erzsébet and Wirth Pál & Mart Éva; the FamilySearch derivative index for this entry (ARK 1:1:VJRW-GQY / 1:1:VJRW-GQR) gives an incorrect year (1881) and place (Bogyiszló)
